title: Don't Throw Away Your Box Grater
text:
Don't Throw Away Your Box Grater. This arrived today just as I was getting ready to shred some cabbage for slaw. I washed the parts an pieces and thought I would give it a try. What I know:

Skimpy directions on the box. What good is that if I plan to discard the box.
No clear pictures of what the cutting discs produce.
The grater turned my cabbage into mince.
It sticks well to the counter in fact so well that I almost broke the cheap plastic handle off doing a carrot.
No mention of whether it is dishwasher safe.

All in all I won't give up my bent up box grater for this gadget.
